body:
AMEND — codex-component-ledger-review. Two bounded anti-dither defects remain; both are identity or representability defects, not implementation preferences.

1. Reproducibility and identity failure: ExpectedDataId hashes parallel projections of selected content, not the complete canonical semantic payload. The formula omits the separately declared local axis and relation fixture table and does not explicitly bind caseId, owner, class, controlCaseId, mutation base, changed-field and mutated digests, or detecting court. Those fields determine reference resolution, mutation pairing, and which C1 law a row evidences. Two court-distinct artifacts can therefore retain one ExpectedDataId. Hash each complete canonical case record atomically plus the complete canonical header and fixture declarations, excluding only self IDs and derivation, review, and realization receipts. Freeze ordering and normalization for every nested collection; do not rely on map iteration or separately ordered parallel vectors.

2. Unrepresentable mutation law and scientific conflation: exactly one changed field describes a structural input-data mutation, while B04 also requires swap, relabel, reorder, discard, and other forbidden repair or guard mutations. Swapping PTS and DTS changes two scalar fields, and removing a guard is not an expected-data field change. Separate typed input mutations from forbidden-repair or guard mutations, or encode the latter as one typed MutationOp applied to a referenced base. Every leaf must have its own caseId and controlCaseId; baseDigest must equal the canonical digest of that control; mutatedDigest must equal the derived mutant; and the one-change law must be mechanically checkable at the declared field or operator granularity.

The requested separation otherwise passes. ExpectedDataId, DerivationReceiptId, and ReviewReceiptId are non-inheriting identities; worksheet or review changes do not rewrite the expected mathematical object. OracleRealizationId is future and implementation-bound, C1 cannot mint it, and C1 receives only conformance authority against ExpectedDataId. The claim ceiling therefore smuggles no generator, runtime, source, or implementation authority.

After these two repairs I would ACCEPT. This review grants no code, runtime, bead, candidate, source, or implementation authority.
